backups.title: Backups
backups.intro: A backup copies the whole service - every account, trip and photograph - into one archive. Restoring one replaces everything that is here now.
backups.none: Nothing is being backed up yet.
backups.localHint: Archives are kept in the directory this server was configured with. Keep a copy somewhere else as well: a disk that fails takes both the service and its backups.
backups.hostKeyHint: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3... - leave empty to accept the key the server presents the first time and hold it to that key afterwards.
backups.secretKept: Stored - leave empty to keep it
backups.encrypt: Lock the archives with a passphrase
backups.passphraseWarning: Without this passphrase the archives cannot be opened, by anybody. Keep it somewhere other than this server.
backups.scheduleHint: A cron expression: minute, hour, day of the month, month, day of the week. "0 3 * * *" is every night at three.
backups.retainDays: How many days to keep them
backups.withdrawQuestion: Stop this backup? The archives it has already written stay where they are and can still be restored.
backups.noRuns: Nothing has been backed up yet.
backups.interrupted: Interrupted by a restart; it will not finish.
backups.restoreWarning: Everything here is replaced by what the archive holds: accounts, trips, reports and photographs. You will be signed out unless your account is in the archive too. This cannot be undone.
backups.passphraseOwn: Leave empty to use this backup's own passphrase
backups.restoreElsewhere: An archive from another server is copied into this server's backup directory on the host first, or restored there with tripvault-backend --restore.
backups.restoreQuestion: Replace everything on this server with the contents of this archive?
